g.text: 19. leaderless (closer-in-flight): the field engine, rung 2, "flank", seed 3, 617.75 s to 1199.75 s
the leader is down and the closer lives. Men: 90, 161. Body: hastati, second century.
+ a slot, joined to its man when he is away from it · □ the standard · ○ the men the flag is about · red line: a bout
